name: jr-awake
description: Keeps the Mac awake while Claude works, shared by every session on the machine, and warns before the next sleep.

mode.title: Default mode
mode.description: working: awake while Claude works in any session. session: awake while any session is open. off. /jrawake changes it for every session.

keepDisplay.title: Keep the display on too
keepDisplay.description: Also prevent the display from sleeping while the Mac is held awake.

warnAtSeconds.title: Warn before sleep (s)
warnAtSeconds.description: A toast when the Mac will sleep within this many seconds.

showBand.title: Show the band
showBand.description: A line above the prompt while the Mac is held awake or about to sleep.
